headers.//: Headers match the REQUESTED path, not the rewrite destination. SPA routes like / and /w/abc never match '/index.html', so the HTML rule must be '**'. Asset rule comes after so it overrides for hashed files.

connect-src lists what the Firebase SDK actually talks to: Identity Toolkit and Secure Token for auth, Firestore for data. img-src allows www.google.com because Firestore's WebChannel transport fetches cleardot.gif from there to probe the connection — without it the browser blocks the probe on every session. 'unsafe-inline' on style-src is required because React writes inline style attributes; there are no inline scripts, so script-src stays strict. Verified against a real build in Chromium. If a Firebase feature is added later (Storage, Analytics, popup sign-in) its origin must be added here or the call will be blocked.
headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https://www.google.com; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com https://securetoken.googleapis.com https://firestore.googleapis.com https://*.googleapis.com; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'

headers.//: frame-ancestors above covers modern browsers; this is the older equivalent.
Ticket URLs carry a workshop and registration ID, so keep them off third-party referers.

headers.value: camera=(), microphone=(), geolocation=(), payment=(), usb=(), interest-cohort=()
